event: Identify the relative location of a water dripping sound when a robot is standing by a light-gray armchair closer to a wall painting and facing a light-gray three-seater couch.

sounding_object.description: Keurig K-Slim Single Serve K-Cup Pod Coffee Maker, black. It is located on the kitchen counter. This is the source of the water dripping/brewing sound.

reference_object.object_name: Light-gray armchair closer to the wall painting
reference_object.description: A light-gray upholstered armchair located in the living room, next to a fireplace which has a wall painting above it. This is where the robot is positioned.

facing_object.description: A light-gray, fabric-upholstered three-seater couch with throw pillows, located in the living room. This is the object the robot is facing.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the light-gray armchair closer to the wall painting and facing the light-gray three-seater couch, when the water dripping sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
